summary: fractal-ui ships a Transcript composition and a plain-language sync line, with consent-gated Markdown images and a host-owned retry for a failed send

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes; no protocol, harness or CLI change. The package exports Transcript, TranscriptFeedback and EmbraceScrollViewport, and the conversation model gains an optional sendState that the host may leave unreported. Sync line wording changes; its inputs do not.
